anchor_source: Wilder, New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems, 1978
anchor_text: A 14-day RSI reading below 30 indicates an oversold condition and is commonly used as a mean-reversion entry signal.

anchor_source: Kelly 1956; Thorp, The Kelly Capital Growth Investment Criterion
